title: Xcape Room Fresno
specs: Rooms are air conditioned at about 70 degrees
All ages welcome; recommended for ages 13 and up
Must be 18 or older or have a parent/legal guardian sign waiver before participation
Parent/guardian waiver required for minors before arrival if guardian not present
Ideal group size is 6 people; can accommodate special cases by inquiry
includes: 3 clues included per room; option to pre-purchase unlimited clues for +$10
gap: Exact age minimum for participation not stated beyond waiver requirement
blurb: Guests participate in themed escape rooms where they solve puzzles and clues to escape within one hour. Rooms have different stories and difficulty levels. The experience emphasizes teamwork, critical thinking, and problem solving under time pressure.
extraNote: All payments must be made upfront to confirm booking; accepts debit, credit, and cash · Extra clues purchased onsite cost $5 each and are non-refundable · Pre-purchased unlimited clues cost +$10 and are non-refundable · For special scheduling requests outside operating hours, contact by email or phone
